verdict.rationale: Mistral's batch-processing docs state that batching runs asynchronous inference on large inputs at a documented 50% discount, which directly matches the story. The evidence is a single first-party snippet, so the depth of the job workflow is not shown. Missing for 10: details of the job submission and lifecycle mechanics (completion window, model eligibility, status polling), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the discount.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can submit asynchronous batch jobs at a documented discount versus real-time pricing

citations.quote: Batching allows you to run asynchronous inference on large inputs in parallel, reducing compute costs while running large workloads at a 50% discount.
